#### What type of PR is this?

/kind cleanup
/kind failing-test
/sig storage
/cc @pohly @msau42 

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

The volume metric tests in the gce-cos-master-serial job have been failing according to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/105965 and https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/106008, more recently a PR related with CSIMigration and removing some resources installed by default  https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/104722 was merged, after this last merge all the volume metric errors were skipped however from the previous issues we know that they're true negatives, to test that they are true negatives I did the following:

- Installed PD CSI
- Installed a default StorageClass that uses PD CSI

```
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: standard
  annotations:
    storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: "true"
provisioner: pd.csi.storage.gke.io
parameters:
  type: pd-standard
allowVolumeExpansion: true
```

- Rerun the tests and saw the failures 

As mentioned in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105970#discussion_r740661358, the status counts were moved from a counter to an existing histogram (they're now another label), the fix consists in:

- Moving the status count code to be part of the histogram
- Consider cases where CSIMigration is turned on, in that case the pv_controller won't emit the volume_provision metric so the parts in the e2e test that test it were removed

Results:

```
./hack/ginkgo-e2e.sh --ginkgo.focus="Volume.metrics" --allowed-not-ready-nodes=10 --storage.testdriver="/usr/local/google/home/mauriciopoppe/go/src/sigs.k8s.io/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/test/k8s-integration/config/test-config-linux.yaml"

Ran 19 of 7291 Specs in 1382.781 seconds
SUCCESS! -- 19 Passed | 0 Failed | 0 Pending | 7272 Skipped
PASS
```

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
<!--
*Automatically closes linked issue when PR is merged.
Usage: `Fixes #<issue number>`, or `Fixes (paste link of issue)`.
_If PR is about `failing-tests or flakes`, please post the related issues/tests in a comment and do not use `Fixes`_*
-->
Even though the metric tests are skipped now that the PD CSI Driver is not installed by default, it fixes all the volume metric related errors.
